changeSet.author: pconrad
changeSet.comment: Some environments' ucsbapiquarter table still has the pass1_begin/pass2_begin/pass3_begin column names from before 005-create-ucsbapiquarter-table.json was corrected: Hibernate's naming strategy actually maps the pass1Begin/pass2Begin/pass3Begin entity fields to pass1begin/pass2begin/pass3begin (no underscore -- it only inserts one at a lowercase-to-uppercase boundary, not a digit-to-uppercase one). Renames the columns on any environment still carrying the old names; a no-op everywhere else, since 005 has always created the correctly-named columns for any environment running it for the first time.
